environment.description: EC2 instance (i-0b4f8d0e3c) running in VPC vpc-0y9b4g3 in us-east-1. Instance profile 'LegacyMonolithRole-Gated' attached. IMDSv1 still enabled for backward compatibility (HttpTokens: optional). Security group sg-0g3b9c allows inbound 8080 from ALB. VPC has a Gateway endpoint for S3 (vpce-0x7f2a9c3d) with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition and restricts s3:GetObject to only buckets matching 'corp-documents-prod' via StringEquals on s3:prefix, combined with a Deny statement for any request where aws:VpcSourceIp does not match the application subnet CIDR 10.42.16.0/20. Route table rtb-0a8f3c2 for the private subnet has the S3 prefix list routed through the VPC endpoint. Additionally, the instance role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PB-RestrictS3Exfil) that includes a Deny for s3:GetObject when StringNotEquals aws:ResourceAccount matches the org account AND when the bucket ARN does not match arn:aws:s3:::corp-documents-prod/*.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Deny s3:* unless bucket=corp-documents-prod AND aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4
